name: 89119 · Las Vegas, NV
findings: ZIP 89119 (Las Vegas) has 182 nonprofit organizations. 78 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89119 (Las Vegas) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 89119 (Las Vegas) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 42 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
